rule.pnl: funding received + futures return - perp return, per weekday mark, as a fraction of one leg
rule.judge_at: 2027-05-04 (six months of holdout) or earlier only to stop on a kill
rule.success: total net P&L over the holdout > 0, positive in at least 4 of the 6 calendar months, and the average month above its own standard error
rule.kill: stop and record a miss if net P&L is below -5% of one leg at any month-end, or if 30-day average funding is negative for 30 straight days
rule.prior_evidence: Exploratory only (studies/natgas_explore.py, 144 weekdays Apr to Oct 2026): funding +26.4% of one leg, basis +12.8% (two days above 5% carry most of it), total +39.2%; without those two days +21.0% with a 0.75% daily standard deviation. One regime, six months, six looks taken on the same data.
rule.mechanism: Holders of the perp are mostly long-gas buyers, so funding is positive in 82% of hours; the hedge needs a futures account, which limits who can earn it, and the market is small (open interest about $12M).
rule.main_risks: basis jumps when the reference contract rolls (5% to 12% days seen), funding turning negative (18% of hours), liquidation of the short at 10x if gas spikes, venue and oracle risk, and a crowded trade once discovered.
